subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and ship this status-only Wear OS companion as an official Android surface once release versioning is repaired?
rationale: The implementation establishes a new maintained application, dependency set, CI surface, and foundation for the open conversation follow-up; code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants to own that product line.

options.title: Sponsor the staged Wear surface
options.body: Approve the phone-first status slice, require the distinct Wear version-code repair and release validation, and review later capabilities separately.

options.title: Defer official Wear support
options.body: Pause or close this PR and its dependent follow-up until Android roadmap ownership and release commitments are explicitly established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged Wear surface
recommendation.body: Approve the phone-first status slice, require the distinct Wear version-code repair and release validation, and review later capabilities separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies this person as the Android application owner. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/android/README.md?utm_source=openai))
